create_cache_counter: create a CacheCounter instance with a name, stat enum, log function, and logging frequency
add_stat_to_counter: add a stat enum value to the CacheCounter to track cache hits and misses
compute_cache_hit_rate: compute the cache hit rate from a Counter using CacheStat.cache_hit_rate class method
get_download_failure_rate: get the download failure rate from a Counter using DownloadStat.failure_rate class method
log_cache_stats: log cache statistics periodically using CacheCounter.log_stat with a custom log function
